hosts-override.title: External Software Interfering With Lunar Client
hosts-override.description: It looks like you have software installed that is interfering with Lunar Client's ability to connect to our servers. This is often caused by antivirus software, VPNs, or software that intentionally interferes with Lunar Client. Please disable or uninstall any software that may be interfering.

file-permission.title: External Software Interfering With Lunar Client
file-permission.description: It looks like something is interfering with Lunar Client's ability to read or write data to your computer. This is often caused by permission issues or software that intentionally interferes with Lunar Client. Please disable or uninstall any software that may be interfering.

import.title: This pack can run commands on your computer
import.description: "{{modpackName}}" includes launch settings that can run programs or change your game's environment. Choose which to keep — anything left unchecked won't be imported.
import.warning: Only keep these if you trust where this pack came from. They can execute commands on your computer every time you launch.

clone.title: This profile runs commands on your computer
clone.description: "{{modpackName}}" includes launch settings that can run programs or change your game's environment. Choose which to copy into the clone — anything left unchecked won't be copied.
clone.warning: These run on your computer every time you launch the cloned profile.

export.title: This profile runs commands on your computer
export.description: "{{modpackName}}" includes launch settings that can run programs or change your game's environment. Choose which to include in the exported pack — anything left unchecked won't be shared.
export.warning: Anyone you share this pack with will receive these and they'll run on their computer. Don't include anything private like tokens or passwords.
